set.name: Volcano Racers Series 1: The Ember Heart Saga
set.status: Concept v2 (collectible TCG layout). Moves, Grit, types and back copy are proposals for Harrison to approve. Final art is Harrison's.

epic.label: Epic
epic.note: The Phantom, the airship, the garage team card

legendary.label: Legendary
legendary.frame: Gold foil frame (spot foil on print)

secret.label: Secret
secret.frame: Full Art: art covers the whole card, holo
secret.note: Full Art Blaze, Ember and Gearlock, numbered 21-23 (above the 20-card set)

cards.name: Blaze
cards.flavor: The fastest thing alive. At top speed she leaves her own shadow panting at the start line.
cards.lock: Golden cheetah, glowing spots, red bandana, lightning pendant, knee brace under the tights.

ability.name: Shadow Left Behind
ability.text: Once per race, Blaze may move twice in one turn. If she does, she takes 1 Scar.

moves.name: Rooster Tail
moves.text: Black sand in the face. The opponent's next move costs 1 more Fuel.

moves.name: Top Speed
moves.text: Flip a coin. Tails: Blaze's knee takes 30 damage that never heals.

cards.gag: Pure speed. Her shadow is left panting at the start line.
cards.quiet: Alone, the brace pulled down, the knee swollen.

cards.name: Captain Quackers
cards.flavor: Thirty trophies, one dented helmet, and the worst luck on Cinder Isle. Usually seen as a soot silhouette with blinking eyes.
cards.lock: Short mallard, green head, yellow jumpsuit, dented orange helmet.

ability.name: Soot and Blinking
ability.text: When an explosion knocks Quackers out, put him back in play next turn with 10 Grit.

moves.name: Backfire Launch
moves.text: Quackers also takes 20.

moves.name: Thirty-Trophy Tantrum
moves.text: If Quackers is soot-black, this does 40 more.

cards.gag: Blown up, plucked bare, re-dressed in a pink feather duster.
cards.quiet: Asleep in #02 among thirty dusty trophies, alone.

cards.name: Jackrabbit Joe
cards.flavor: Two years sober. Flips the chip like a coin and leans on whatever's nearby at forty-five degrees.
cards.lock: Lanky tan jackrabbit, black-tipped ears, patched aviator jacket, carrot in hand.

ability.name: Two-Year Chip
ability.text: At the start of your turn, flip the chip. Heads: heal 20.

moves.name: Lean On It
moves.text: Joe can't be bumped during your opponent's next turn.

moves.name: Asleep at the Wheel
moves.text: Joe falls asleep. He still counts as pushing.

cards.quiet: Putting the cloth back over the bottles like making a hospital bed.

cards.name: Pip
cards.flavor: Thumb-sized, overlooked, and the smartest one in the garage. Memories flash in his goggles.
cards.lock: Tiny white mouse, huge brass goggles, red scarf, tool belt.

ability.name: Pop-Out Wings
ability.text: Once per race, Pip's car glides over one hazard.

moves.name: Wrench Toss
moves.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

moves.name: Pocket Gizmo
moves.text: Attach a Gadget card from your discard pile to Pip.

cards.gag: Upside down under a car, wrenches in his mouth, paws and tail.
cards.quiet: His paw on the folded NDA in his tool belt, not taking it out.

cards.name: Duke Whiskers
cards.flavor: “I meant to do that.” A smile built for cameras, and sunglasses he never takes off on air.
cards.lock: Chubby orange-and-cream tabby, gold aviators, purple racing jacket.

ability.name: SNEAKY Lever
ability.text: Once per turn, play a Trick card for free. If it backfires, Duke takes the damage.

moves.name: Smile for the Camera
moves.text: Your opponent can't use abilities during their next turn.

moves.name: I Meant to Do That
moves.text: Duke flattens into a pancake. Flip a coin. Tails: Duke takes 30.

cards.gag: Flattened into a cat-shaped pancake, sunglasses still on.
cards.quiet: In a bathroom stall, sunglasses set aside, phone in both paws.

cards.name: Ember
cards.flavor: All teeth and fire for one panel. Then a lonely, gentle dad who just wants friends.
cards.lock: Huge round red-orange dragon, cream belly, small wings, checkered cap. Colour fades with his fire.

ability.name: Fading Fire
ability.text: Each time Ember attacks, put a Fade counter on him. With 4 Fade counters, his moves do 40 less.

moves.name: Big Hug
moves.text: Spines pop like bubble wrap. Heal Ember 30.

moves.name: Heart of the Volcano
moves.text: Put 2 Fade counters on Ember.

cards.gag: Drops two car engines on his own feet.
cards.quiet: Coughing grey ash into his fist and hiding the rag.

cards.name: Flicker
cards.flavor: Sneezes sparks. Bless you. Duck.
cards.lock: Dog-sized red dragon hatchling.

moves.name: Spark Sneeze
moves.text: Flip a coin. Heads: the opponent's racer is Scorched.

cards.name: Cinder
cards.flavor: Hides behind things. Behind you, mostly.
cards.lock: Dog-sized grey-blue dragon hatchling.

moves.name: Hide Behind Dad
moves.text: If Ember is on your bench, Cinder takes no damage during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Spark
cards.flavor: Mouth always open. Questions always coming.
cards.lock: Dog-sized yellow dragon hatchling.

moves.name: Why Why Why
moves.text: Your opponent shows you their hand.

cards.name: Wren
cards.flavor: Her father's daughter, and determined not to look like him. Tall where he is squat, calm where he explodes.
cards.lock: Lean young mallard, green-and-white racing suit, number #19.

moves.name: Junior Champion
moves.text: If Captain Quackers is in play, this does 30 more.

cards.name: Baron Gearlock
cards.flavor: Polished on camera, a scared kid from the Undergear underneath. The brass wing clanks a beat behind the real one.
cards.lock: Tall bony black crow, top hat, monocle, brass mechanical left wing.

ability.name: Smile Flicker
ability.text: When one of your Trick cards fails, Gearlock heals 30. The smile comes back brighter.

moves.name: Brass Wing Clank
moves.text: The wing clanks a beat late: this does 20 more next turn.

moves.name: The Last Great Ring Rally
moves.text: Each of your opponent's cars in play takes 30.

cards.gag: His smile flickers for one frame, then comes back brighter.
cards.quiet: Sweeping the pit lane, top hat gone.

cards.name: The Phantom
cards.flavor: Black armor, white mask, no mouth. The one racer every gag bounces off.
cards.lock: Masked racer in black armor with a smooth white mask. Runs with Blaze's stride.

ability.name: No Mouth, No Squash
ability.text: Prevent all effects of Toon moves on the Phantom.

moves.name: Mirror Stride
moves.text: Use the last move Blaze used this race.

moves.name: Shard Rush
moves.text: The Phantom takes 1 Scar.

cards.gag: Rare, on purpose. Gags bounce off him.
cards.quiet: Out of breath, keeping up the only way he can.

cards.name: GearCorp Airship
cards.flavor: Six smokestacks, a giant claw, and a face on the belly screen. Every inch is a billboard.
cards.lock: Gunmetal hull, six smog stacks, glowing GearCorp logos, LED belly screen, hanging claw.

ability.name: Every Inch a Billboard
ability.text: Your Gear cards cost 1 less Fuel.

moves.name: Sticker Drone
moves.text: Stamp a GEARCORP sticker. The target can't take a pit stop.

moves.name: Claw Drop
moves.text: Put one of your opponent's cars into their pit.

cards.name: #02 Roadster
cards.flavor: Backfires hard enough to launch like a rocket. Explodes, then shows up in the next panel anyway.
cards.lock: Yellow, stubby 1950s open roadster, black #02 in a white roundel, one dent.
cards.vehicle_rule: Attach to Captain Quackers or Wren. The driver gets +30 Grit. Backfire: once per race, move 2 spaces and the driver takes 10.

cards.name: #07 Cruiser
cards.flavor: A tire fell off at inspection. “It's a style.” There's a bird nest on the roof.
cards.lock: Old dusty green 1960s cruiser, bird nest on the roof, seat reclined flat.
cards.vehicle_rule: Attach to Jackrabbit Joe. The driver gets +20 Grit. It's a style: when a tire falls off, nothing happens.

cards.name: #11 Micro
cards.flavor: Toaster-sized. Pop-out wings, thimble wheels, a grappling cable. Drives on tunnel ceilings.
cards.lock: Tiny blue bubble-cockpit car full of gizmos, brass fittings.
cards.vehicle_rule: Attach to Pip. Pip's Gadget cards cost 1 less Fuel. Can race on tunnel ceilings.

cards.name: #44 Supercar
cards.flavor: Oil slick, net cannon, boxing glove: all on the red SNEAKY lever. Steering pulls left four degrees.
cards.lock: Purple and silver wedge supercar, gold wheels, oversized red SNEAKY lever.
cards.vehicle_rule: Attach to Duke Whiskers. Duke may hold 2 extra Trick cards. Steering pulls left: flip a coin each corner.

bio.Quirk: Oil slick, net cannon, boxing glove

cards.name: #19 Junior
cards.flavor: Clean where her father's car is battered. For now.
cards.lock: Lean modern junior-league car, green and white.
cards.vehicle_rule: Attach to Wren. The driver's first move each race costs 1 less Fuel.

cards.name: Four Cars Gleam
cards.flavor: Four team cars, one empty bay with a hand-painted sign: “BLAZE??”
cards.lock: Garage scene: #02, #07, #11 and #44, plus the empty bay. No sponsor logos on Cinder Isle.
cards.location_rule: No Logo Law: while this card is in play, GearCorp cards cost 1 more Fuel.

holo.label: Holo
holo.note: Rare, Epic and Legendary cards print on holo foil frames.

reverse_holo.label: Reverse holo parallel
reverse_holo.note: Any card. Foil everywhere except the art window.

scar_foil.label: Scar foil parallel, numbered /50
scar_foil.note: Any card. Scar-red foil frame, hand-numbered on the back.

full_art.label: Full Art secret rare (21/20 to 23/20)
full_art.note: Blaze, Ember and Gearlock with art covering the whole card.

stat_notes: Character stats use the card battle game's names (Speed = distance, Power = bump damage, Grit = health, Toon = gag damage that bounces off). Values are proposals.
